e.title: insurance-telematics
e.summary: HMM 车联网风险评分（burning-cost，MIT）：隐马尔可夫模型的驾驶行为定价
e.body: insurance-telematics（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）用隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）做车联网风险评分：从驾驶状态序列（加速/刹车/转向）学习隐状态并打分——UBI 定价的模型方法。对 RIAA：车联网定价的模型进阶——[[driver-behavior-telematics]]（行为分类）的时序建模版（HMM 捕捉驾驶状态转移）；与 [[grab-aiforsea-safety]]（竞赛实现）配套：模型 + 数据；「驾驶状态 → 风险评分」的 UBI 定价前沿；车联网定价课程的模型工具。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：burning-cost 仓库 + PyPI 确认（HMM 车联网风险评分，MIT），未实测
e.summary_en: HMM telematics risk scoring (burning-cost, MIT): hidden-Markov-model driving-behaviour pricing
e.summary_hk: HMM 車聯網風險評分（burning-cost，MIT）：隱馬爾可夫模型的駕駛行為定價
e.body_en: insurance-telematics (burning-cost, PyPI, MIT) applies hidden Markov models (HMM) to telematics risk scoring: learning hidden states from driving-state sequences (acceleration/braking/steering) and scoring risk — a model approach to UBI pricing. For RIAA: a modelling upgrade for telematics pricing — the time-series version of [[driver-behavior-telematics]] (behaviour classification): HMM captures driving-state transitions; with [[grab-aiforsea-safety]] (competition implementation) it forms model + data; the 'driving-state → risk score' UBI-pricing frontier; a model tool for telematics-pricing courses.
e.body_hk: insurance-telematics（burning-cost，PyPI，MIT）用隱馬爾可夫模型（HMM）做車聯網風險評分：從駕駛狀態序列（加速/剎車/轉向）學習隱狀態並打分——UBI 定價的模型方法。對 RIAA：車聯網定價的模型進階——[[driver-behavior-telematics]]（行為分類）的時序建模版（HMM 捕捉駕駛狀態轉移）；與 [[grab-aiforsea-safety]]（競賽實現）配套：模型 + 數據；「駕駛狀態 → 風險評分」的 UBI 定價前沿；車聯網定價課程的模型工具。
